narrative_engine.thesis: 2.35σ VWAP stretch detected, but the anti-knife-catching gate is not satisfied (price 2.35σ from VWAP but no crowding signal yet (RSI 58, funding n/a% APR, top L/S n/a)). Wait for the footprint to print exhaustion/trap/absorption or a defending wall before fading — or for the ±3σ flush.

funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
